snippet.title: Hordes of Fate : A Hand of Fate Adventure | Indie Fan Fest | Feb 2026
snippet.description:
Hordes of Fate: A Hand of Fate Adventure
 
In Hordes of Fate the Dealer returns once again, this time not to play the game of Life and Death, but instead to train a new challenger to rise against it.
 
The challenger has, through dark and elaborate arts, journeyed to the Void, the place beyond Life and Death where the Dealer was banished after the events of Hand of Fate 2.  
 
Nobody arrives at the Void intact.  The player's memories have become fragmented and scattered, and even the Dealer is isolated from the power of the Game of Life and Death.    
 
Together, they will use the power of the cards to take on hordes of deadly enemies, to return the player's memory, and the Dealers strength.
